title: Apple Is Having Another 'Garden Variety' Correction
text:
Apple Is Having Another 'Garden Variety' Correction By 0
We looked at Apple Inc. (AAPL) earlier this month, and wrote that "AAPL is pointed up. Longs should risk below $180 for now looking for gains to $200, $250, and the $260-$275 area longer-term." The price of AAPL stopped short of $195 and corrected down toward our risk point for traders. Will AAPL soon stabilize and find support around the highs of January, February, March and April? Let's review the charts and indicators again of this name discussed by Jim Cramer Monday night on Mad Money.
In the daily bar chart of Action Alerts PLUS holding AAPL, below, we can see a pattern of rallies and pullbacks or corrections the past 12 months. Prices cross the 50-day moving average a number of times and the rising 200-day moving average line is tested in early February and late April.
